source_title: Верховный Совет СССР, внеочередная сессия: Бюллетень No. 1 совместного заседания Совета Союза и Совета Национальностей, 26 августа 1991 г. (stenographic bulletin, morning sitting), scanned facsimile, Internet Archive capture 20250718143607; recorded for the Soyuz group

live_file_response.note: The live static file on the non-official SSSR.SU host, byte-identical to the recorded capture; requested without Accept-Encoding and served without Content-Encoding.

stability_check: Discovery: the independent check downloaded the raw capture at 2026-09-29T01:43:30Z and the live file at 01:43:31Z; this packet downloaded the live file at 2026-09-29T00:05:20Z and the capture at 02:03:44Z; identical bytes. This packet: downloaded at 2026-09-29T02:11:36Z and again at 2026-09-29T02:43:11Z (31 minutes later) with plain curl (curl's own User-Agent, 'Accept-Encoding: identity', no cookies, no cache-busting query); identical 2,252,696 bytes and SHA-256; the attached responses also matched on both downloads. The base32 SHA-1 of the recorded bytes equals the Internet Archive CDX digest ZCGGKKXUWMPIIQHDCKF2ITXG5FHRLVFA.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of https://sten.vs.sssr.su/12/6/1.pdf, captured at 2025-07-18T14:36:07Z, before the 7 September 2026 cutoff; requested with 'Accept-Encoding: identity' (curl without --compressed) and served without Content-Encoding, so the recorded identity is the uncompressed body as replayed (a request accepting gzip may be served gzip-encoded, with different bytes). The same bytes are served as a static file by the live host (live_file_response); the capture is recorded as the identity because it is fixed before the cutoff. The original response is not checked into this repository; this checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Attributed factual paraphrases only; no source artwork or portrait copied, and no photograph, emblem, signature image or expressive source text is republished. No open license is asserted. No portrait permission or likeness approval is established.
scope_note: The official stenographic bulletin of the morning sitting of 26 August 1991, a page-image scan with an ABBYY FineReader 11 OCR layer. The same file is already recorded for CLAUDE-C01-26 as su_sten_vs_bulletin1_19910826 (as the live file); it is recorded again here, as its pre-cutoff raw capture, so that the CLAUDE-C01-26 extract and its CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review stay unchanged. PDF pp. 1, 3 and 22 were read for the Soyuz group.

edition_and_host.edition: Верховный Совет СССР. Внеочередная сессия. Бюллетень № 1 совместного заседания Совета Союза и Совета Национальностей, 26 августа 1991 г. (cover and contents, PDF p. 1); 64 PDF pages, printed p. N on PDF p. N for the cited pages.
edition_and_host.host: SSSR.SU portal (snd.sssr.su, sten.vs.sssr.su): a non-commercial project registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345), not a state body and not the publisher; it serves page-image scans of the official stenographic reports as static files (see the CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review of the same host).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; the sitting headings, speaker lines and quotations were compared with the image, and the title page and imprint were read for the edition.

persons_named: И. Д. Лаптев (Председатель Совета Союза, presiding)
rows.role_title: Сопредседатель депутатской группы «Союз» — Co-chair of the Soyuz deputies' group
rows.text: At the morning sitting of 26 August 1991 ('Председательствует Председатель Совета Союза Верховного Совета СССР И. Д. Лаптев'), 'Богданов И. М., г. Нижний Новгород' says: 'В мае руководители группы «Союз» на весь автобус кричали, что «скоро вас, демократов, отсюда выбросят».'
rows.locator: Bulletin No. 1: sitting heading, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 3); remark, printed p. 22 (PDF p. 22)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
